brief:
Israel carried out a series of airstrikes targeting multiple towns and areas across southern Lebanon on Wednesday evening, killing one person and wounding two others, Shehab Wire reported. An Israeli soldier documented footage of detonating a Lebanese home, appearing to celebrate the operation.

The airstrikes mark the latest violations of the ceasefire agreement between Israel and Lebanon. Since the truce took effect, Israel has committed 7,700 breaches of the agreement, according to the report. The renewed strikes underscore escalating tensions along the border despite the formal cessation of hostilities.
